title: The Lock Call: Wednesday, November 25
blurb: Merv takes the top of the board from Leslie, a turkey runs for the bushes and gets pardoned anyway, and Edwin asks where to apply.

lines.text: [mock outrage] I went oh and two, and Merv took my spot on top of the board!
[grinning] And a turkey ran into the bushes and still got a pardon. Eight picks. Go!
From The Window at Hardwood Bricks, this is Tops and Bottoms, the Lock Call. I'm Brett Busberger.
And I'm Leslie Phyllis, humbled. Brett, the president pardoned two turkeys yesterday. Freedom and Feathers. He said the names were good, but he's heard better.
And Feathers ran off into the bushes, and got pardoned anyway.
[wheezing] That's my kind of deal. I went oh and two. Where do I apply?
[dry] A pardon needs a conviction, Edwin. Lucky for you, the board has plenty.
Today's picks, from the top. The under, one forty-six and a half, Omaha and U C Davis. And Davidson, laying eight and a half against Tulane.
Over one fifty and a half, Southern Utah and Long Beach State. And U N C Wilmington, laying seven against Saint Thomas.
And the machine has Saint Thomas, plus seven. Sorry, Leslie. Also Texas State, laying twenty-three and a half against Alcorn State.
[out of breath] S I U Edwardsville, plus four at home. And the over, one thirty-nine. Somebody's buying every rubber duck in South Jersey. You didn't hear it from me.
The board. Rough night. The house went two and six.
Which puts an old man on top. Eight, three and one, up four point two eight units.
I'm second. Eight and four. Brett's seven, four and one. And Edwin is five and seven.
[grumbling] The turkey gets a farm in Texas. I get this.
That's the Lock Call. The picks column is up now at hardwood bricks dot com. Happy Thanksgiving eve.
Twenty-one and up. If gambling's a problem, call one eight hundred GAMBLER.
Keep it mid. Keep it real.

news.item: On Tuesday Nov 24 at the White House, President Trump pardoned two turkeys, Freedom and Feathers. He said the names were "good, but I've heard better." Feathers ran off into the bushes and was pardoned anyway. The birds retire to Texas A&M.

notes.board: Standings through Nov 24; yesterday = Nov 24 card (house 2-6).
